s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial skin lesions with pain, swelling, and erythema, with a history of breast carcinoma
salient_findings: Violaceous swelling with telangiectasia and necrosis on the face
Hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and dilated vessels in the dermis
Nests of highly atypical cells in a dilated vessel
key_facts: Woman in her 60s
3-month history of pain, swelling, and erythema on her face
History of left breast carcinoma diagnosed eleven years earlier
Treated with mastectomy, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy
Left supraclavicular lymph nodes metastasis treated with surgical excision seven years after initial diagnosis
Pain on palpation, no fever or chills
Telangiectatic, swelling erythema mainly involving the left side of the forehead, eyelids, nose, and cheek
Histopathological examination showed hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and dilated vessels in the dermis
Immunohistochemical examination showed epithelial cells in the dilated vessels were positive for CD31, and the atypical cells were strongly positive for GATA3

shortlist.label: Cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of breast carcinoma and histopathological examination showing atypical cells in dilated vessels

shortlist.label: Telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma (TMBC)
shortlist.why_kept: Telangiectatic, swelling erythema mainly involving the left side of the forehead, eyelids, nose, and cheek, with immunohistochemical examination showing epithelial cells positive for CD31 and atypical cells positive for GATA3

shortlist.label: Carcinoma erysipeloides
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation of pain, swelling, and erythema on the face, with a history of breast carcinoma

shortlist.label: Postradiation angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of radiotherapy for breast carcinoma and presence of atypical vascular lesions

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathological examination showing dilated vessels with atypical cells, and immunohistochemical examination showing epithelial cells positive for CD31

raw.rationale: The patient's history of breast carcinoma, the presence of telangiectatic swelling and erythema on the face, and the histopathological findings of atypical cells in dilated vessels with positive immunohistochemical staining for GATA3 support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of breast carcinoma, the specific telangiectatic presentation and histopathological findings are more characteristic of TMBC.

rejected.label: Carcinoma erysipeloides
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with a more diffuse, erythematous rash, rather than the telangiectatic, swelling erythema seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Postradiation angiosarcoma
rejected.why: Although the patient has a history of radiotherapy, the presence of atypical cells in dilated vessels with positive staining for GATA3 suggests a metastatic breast carcinoma rather than a primary angiosarcoma.

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
rejected.why: The patient's history and histopathological findings are more consistent with a metastatic breast carcinoma than a primary angiosarcoma.
